sentences.en: MAN: Good morning, Synmouth Museum
sentences.zh: MAN: 早上好，辛茅斯博物馆。

sentences.en: Can I help you?
sentences.zh: 需要我帮您吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Oh yes
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: Good morning
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: I'm interested in the children's workshops and I'd like a little more information, please
sentences.zh: 我对儿童工作坊很感兴趣，想多了解一些相关信息。

sentences.en: MAN: Do you mean the Art and Craft workshops?
sentences.zh: MAN: 您指的是美术与手工工作坊吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的。

sentences.en: A friend of a friend mentioned them the children do painting and make models and so forth
sentences.zh: 一位朋友的朋友向我提起过这些活动——孩子们可以画画、制作模型等等。

sentences.en: MAN: Yes, of course
sentences.zh: MAN: 是的，当然可以。

sentences.en: Um, where to begin?
sentences.zh: 嗯，该从哪儿说起呢？

sentences.en: First of all, as you probably know, they run every Saturday
sentences.zh: 首先，您可能已经知道，这些工作坊每周六都会举办。

sentences.en: Example
sentences.zh: 示例

sentences.en: WOMAN: Fine
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: And what about ages?
sentences.zh: 那么年龄方面有什么要求？

sentences.en: MAN: Well, all ages from five upwards are welcome, though we do ask that children below eight years of age are accompanied by an adult
sentences.zh: MAN: 嗯，欢迎所有五岁及以上的儿童参加；不过我们要求八岁以下的儿童须由一名成人陪同。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Fine
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: That wouldn't be a problem
sentences.zh: 这不会有问题。

sentences.en: What about cost?
sentences.zh: 费用是多少？

sentences.en: MAN: reasonable
sentences.zh: MAN: 价格合理。

sentences.en: It's £2.50 a child, with 80 Well, I think you'll find them very pence off for two or more children from the same family
sentences.zh: 每位儿童收费2.5英镑；若同一家庭有两名或以上儿童参加，则每位可减免80便士。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Oh yes, very reasonable
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哦，是的，非常合理。

sentences.en: And are they held in the main museum?
sentences.zh: 这些活动是在主博物馆内举行吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Not exactly
sentences.zh: MAN: 并不完全如此。

sentences.en: They're nearby
sentences.zh: 地点就在附近。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Could you give me the full address?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 您能告诉我详细地址吗？

sentences.en: I don't know the area very well
sentences.zh: 我对这一带不太熟悉。

sentences.en: MAN: Yes, it's Winter House
sentences.zh: MAN: 当然可以，地址是温特尔大厦（Winter House）。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Right
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: MAN: And that's in Tamer Street
sentences.zh: MAN: 它位于塔默街（Tamer Street）。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Could you spell that please?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 您能拼一下这个街名吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Yes, T-A-M-E-R Street
sentences.zh: MAN: 当然可以，T-A-M-E-R 街。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Lovely
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 太好了。

sentences.en: MAN: And I do need to tell you that there's a security entrance, so you need to press the green button for someone to let you in
sentences.zh: MAN: 我还得提醒您，那里设有安全入口，您需按绿色按钮，才有人为您开门。

sentences.en: Don't press the red button please, but don't worry, it's all clearly labelled
sentences.zh: 请勿按红色按钮；不过别担心，所有标识都非常清晰。

sentences.en: WOMAN: OK
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: And one more question - is parking available nearby?
sentences.zh: 还有一个问题——附近有停车场吗？

sentences.en: We're driving in from out of town
sentences.zh: 我们是从城外开车过来的。

sentences.en: MAN: Your best bet is to leave your car at the back of the library - on a Saturday morning there are plenty of spaces there
sentences.zh: MAN: 您最好的选择是把车停在图书馆后面——周六上午那里有很多空车位。

sentences.en: It's right next door to the museum
sentences.zh: 图书馆就紧邻博物馆。

sentences.en: WOMAN: And can I ask about booking places?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我能问一下场地预订的事吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Yes, and I must tell you, you really should book by calling the education department here
sentences.zh: MAN: 可以，我必须提醒您，您真的应该通过致电本馆的教育部门来预订。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Oh, I'm sorry, should have rung them instead of the main museum number?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哦，抱歉，我本该打教育部门的电话，而不是博物馆总机号码？

sentences.en: MAN: No, that's fine this time, please don't worry
sentences.zh: MAN: 不用担心，这次没关系。

sentences.en: But for future reference, I'll give you the direct number
sentences.zh: 不过为便于今后参考，我这就把教育部门的直拨电话号码告诉您。

sentences.en: It's two hundred-seven-six-five
WOMAN: Great, I've got that
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 太好了，我已经记下了。

sentences.en: SLAN
sentences.zh: SLAN

sentences.en: MAN: But I'm very happy to give you information about the next workshops
sentences.zh: MAN: 不过我很乐意为您介绍接下来的两场工作坊。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Gator day The ToRn Rees Rating Cal les) poSag 6o. com Oh, sounds great!
sentences.zh: WOMAN: ‘鳄鱼日’——The ToRn Rees Rating Cal les) poSag 6o. com——哦，听起来很棒！

sentences.en: MAN: This involves quite a bit of glue, so just make sure the kids are in old clothes
sentences.zh: MAN: 这次活动会用到不少胶水，所以请务必让孩子们穿上旧衣服。

sentences.en: WOMAN: know, ones I don't mind getting mucky
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 明白了，就是那些我不介意弄脏的衣服。

sentences.en: MAN: Exactly
sentences.zh: MAN: 没错。

sentences.en: And if possible, could you bring along bottle tops which the children might be able to use in the models, you know, as decoration?
sentences.zh: 另外，如果可能的话，能否请您带些瓶盖过来？孩子们可以在制作模型时用它们作装饰。

sentences.en: WOMAN: We'll certainly try to find some for you
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我们一定会尽力为您找一些。

sentences.en: MAN: Then the following week
sentences.zh: MAN: 然后是下一周……

sentences.en: WOMAN: That'll be the 23rd, won't it?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那应该是23号，对吧？

sentences.en: MAN: Yes, that's right
sentences.zh: MAN: 对，没错。

sentences.en: On that day, it's what we call Undersea Worlds
sentences.zh: 当天的活动主题是我们称之为‘海底世界’的项目。

sentences.en: This is 09 where they make scenes with fishes, underground caverns and so on
sentences.zh: 这是09号活动，孩子们将用鱼、地下洞穴等元素来制作场景。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Is that likely to get very dirty?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 这次活动会不会弄得特别脏？

sentences.en: Lots of paint splashes?
sentences.zh: 会有很多颜料飞溅吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Not really, so we don't recommend any special clothes for that one
sentences.zh: MAN: 实际上并不会，所以我们不建议为此活动特别准备专用服装。

sentences.en: But if you could search out some silver paper to bring along to use in the sessions, you know, it's shiny it looks like water, that'd be great
sentences.zh: 但如果您能找些锡箔纸带来用于课堂活动就太好了——它闪闪发亮，看起来像水一样。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes, of course
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的，当然可以。

sentences.en: We'll see what we can come up with
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我们看看能准备些什么。

sentences.en: Well, thank you ever so much for all your help
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 非常感谢您的大力帮助。

sentences.en: The sessions sound really good and I'll certainly book up for the next two
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 这些课程听起来真不错，我一定会为接下来的两场报名。

sentences.en: MAN: Lovely
sentences.zh: MAN: 太好了。

sentences.en: Thanks very much for ringing
sentences.zh: MAN: 非常感谢您的来电。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Bye
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 再见。

sentences.en: MAN: Bye-bye
sentences.zh: MAN: 再见。
